notes.title: Patch 1 is OUT NOW for Goblin Cleanup!
notes.content:
[p]Hey Goblins! 👋 
[/p][p][b]Hotfix Patch 1 is now live for Goblin Cleanup![/b] Our tiny team have been hard at work cleaning up bugs you've reported to us since our launch into Steam Early Access. 

Before we jump into fixes, we also want to thank all the Goblins who played our Experimental Beta Branch for this patch yesterday!
[/p][p]We're happy to announce that [b]Hotfix Patch 1 specifically fixes the locked door issue in the Prison level, improves the behavior of Skeletons in the same level, and brings improved Ultrawide support for the Customisation and Shop menus. [/b]Additional fixes are also included, so please see our full patch notes for all details below:
[/p][h2]Hotfix Patch 1 - Patch Notes[/h2][h3]Fixes & Improvements:[/h3][p][/p][list][*][p]General fixes for item desynchronisation in multiplayer, which was particularly affecting Skeletons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed some customisation issues for players with Ultrawide monitors.[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Skeleton in 'The Prison', which now moves around the level easier.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the locked door in 'The Prison' would not open for everyone in a multiplayer lobby.[/p][/*][/list][h3][/h3][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/78d68574620adf08b4a9f4e58ceb38cf9c2b341d.jpg"][/img][/p][h3]Ran into an issue whilst cleaning the dungeons?[/h3][p]If you run into any issues with Goblin Cleanup, please reach out to our Support Team via the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2748340/discussions/1/"]Report a Problem Steam forums here![/url][/p][p] [/p][h3]Want to keep updated on Goblin Cleanup?[/h3][p]Join our [url="https://discord.gg/PWdPKkHVXj"]Discord[/url] and follow us on [url="https://x.com/GoblinCleanup"]Twitter [/url]— we share dev updates, sneak peeks, and goblin nonsense regularly.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you for all your support! 💚[/p]

notes.title: Goblin Cleanup is OUT NOW in Steam Early Access!
notes.content:
[h2]Goblins... the dungeons are ready to be cleaned! 🧹[/h2][p]We are thrilled to announce that [b]Goblin Cleanup is out now in Steam Early Access! [/b]Grab up to three friends and experience our NINE levels at our Early Access launch. These dungeons won't clean themselves, Goblins! ⌛ 

Also, [b]Goblin Cleanup is currently 20% OFF in our Launch Discount[/b] running for two weeks, until October 2nd. You can pick up the game at a discounted price now!

[url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2748340/Goblin_Cleanup/" style="button"]PLAY GOBLIN CLEANUP NOW![/url]
[/p][h3]Watch our new Launch Trailer below: 👇
[/h3][previewyoutube="Iic-BsTVpVk;full"][/previewyoutube][h2]What is Goblin Cleanup? 🧹[/h2][p]In Goblin Cleanup, you will become a professional Goblin Maid, tasked with cleaning and resetting the dungeons for the next adventures![/p][p]Enter the dungeons solo or with up to three Goblin friends, but be cautious as the dungeons are riddled with traps and monsters! You wouldn't want the monsters to eat any of your friends... would you? 👀[/p][h3]Key Features[/h3][p][b]🧌 Become a Goblin Maid and Customise your Character:[/b] Play as a goblin, in solo play or alongside other goblins. Unlock cosmetic items through tickets, which you'll gain by completing dungeon levels, and then design the Goblin of your dreams![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/9d7efdc82904275b9c9ce022b9ccfb3b06858818.gif"][/img][b]🧹 Clean the blood & meat:[/b] You're a professional Goblin Maid, so it's your job to clean up the mess! Head to the slime dispenser, equip your Slimop, and get cleaning. Any meat you find scattered across the dungeon needs to be disposed of... and there's a hungry Mimic who's ready to be fed![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/1a97b029f3374d6b1a241b21f53e4100e752610e.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]🪑 Restore Objects to reset the dungeons:[/b] Objects all have a home in the dungeons, and the previous adventurers have messed all the rooms up! You'll need to place all objects back in their original positions to ensure the dungeon returns to its original state.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/7080d3dc17074b8d62d16c9222bd0e8ab33d9a69.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]⛓️Restore Traps:[/b] What kind of dungeon would it be without traps? It's a dangerous job being a Goblin Maid, as there may be traps across the dungeons that are still active! Explore the levels to restore and reactivate the traps, ready for the next adventurers.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/05c0151340f6ea00c2ab4e67c112a2e604af2ff3.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]👹 Creatures are scattered across the dark dungeons: [/b]Be careful because the dungeons are full of terrors. Across the dungeons you'll meet varied creatures... some friendlier than others! You'll need to respawn creatures, dispose of their remains, and more. Additionally, some creatures might not have perished![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/073f679bc6626b77eeafc505d079aae5c5b5feb0.gif"][/img][/p][h3]We're looking forward to bringing you more news soon around future updates during our Steam Early Access period! More details on our next upcoming update for Goblin Cleanup will arrive in the upcoming days, so keep your eyes peeled for this news on our Steam page 👀

Ran into an issue whilst cleaning the dungeons?[/h3][p]If you run into any issues with Goblin Cleanup, please reach out to our Support Team via the [url="https://steamcommunity.com/app/2748340/discussions/1/"]Report a Problem Steam forums here![/url]
[/p][h3]Have game feedback? Want to keep updated on Goblin Cleanup?[/h3][p]
Join our [url="https://discord.gg/Wc4FEc7H2"]Discord [/url] and follow us on [url="https://x.com/GoblinCleanup"]Twitter [/url]— we share dev updates, sneak peeks, and goblin nonsense regularly.


Thank you for your support! 💚[/p]

notes.title: Goblin Cleanup launches into Steam Early Access on 18th September
notes.content:
[h3]Goblin Cleanup will now launch into Steam Early Access on 18th September.[/h3]

Goblins, [b]we've made the decision to slightly delay Goblin Cleanup's Steam Early Access launch by three weeks.[/b]
 
Our three-person dev team has been working hard with our publisher to add the final polish for Early Access, but our dungeons need a few additional weeks before we open our gates to you and your goblin friends. 
 
Overall, we've made this decision to ensure you have the best co-op cleaning experience at our Steam Early Access launch. Until then, we'll set the traps, so prepare your mops to clean up on [b]18th September![/b]
 
Brave cleaners (and clumsy ones too) can delve into the first few dungeons in our recently updated Steam demo, testing your clean-up skills ahead of our Early Access launch. 
 
We appreciate your support and look forward to sharing more updates soon, including details on Goblin Customisation, both through our Steam page and our [b]@GoblinCleanup[/b] social media accounts!

notes.title: 🎉 We've just updated our Demo! 🎉
notes.content:
Hey Goblins!

It's been a while since our last demo update... so we thought we'd [b]update it with some of the new additions we've been crafting, alongside gameplay improvements, bug fixes, and more![/b]

To start off, [b]we've added our new Staffhub into the demo[/b], which means no more creating a new lobby after cleaning up a level! You can now meet in this shared Staffhub, which allows you to prepare together, select through our demo levels, and like any Staff Room... hang out with cleaning colleagues! 🛋️🧹

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/a12aa65dc6bce66791cf713f2d2864524fe8c802.gif[/img]

Alongside this, we'd like to highlight the addition of third-person camera mode to view your goblin character in all its glory and gameplay improvements, like overhauling of our Mana System for restoring objects on your cleanup adventures. 🔮

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/7dc4939d80574729fac840d9fcdc1bc35481f0f7.gif[/img]

Our demo update brings more improvements and even new enemies to encounter through the dungeons... which you can read more about in our detailed patch notes below: 👇

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/1caa3cfe2058a4de693daa19966a4fa47acc6934.png[/img]
[h2]🧹 Goblin Cleanup - Demo Update - Patch Notes 🧹[/h2]
[h3]✨ Highlights:[/h3]
[list][*] 🆕 [b]Staffhub:[/b] You can now stay in the lobby with your coworkers after finishing a level to start another one together.
[*] 🆕 [b]Third Person View:[/b] Switch between first and third person anytime! There's also a freelook mode to admire your goblin in detail.[/list]
[h3]🎮 Gameplay & Improvements:[/h3]
[list][*] [b]Steam Lobbies: [/b]Public lobby browsing is back! Just make sure the host isn’t already in a level when you try to join.
[*] Key Rebinding (keyboard only)
[*] Voice Chat
[*] New Mana System
[*] [b]Restorables:[/b] You can no longer place a restorative in the wrong type, and active restorables are now highlighted.[/list]
[h3]👾 Enemies:[/h3]
[list][*] Shadow cat might appear when starting a level.
[*] Carnivorous Plant awaits you in the botanical garden...[/list]
[h3]🎨 Polish & Extras:[/h3]
[list][*] Visual improvements across all levels
[*] New music tracks in the staffhub and levels
[*] Credits added
[*] Various bug fixes across the game[/list]
[h2]Missed our previous announcement? 👀[/h2]
In case you missed it, we recently announced [b]Goblin Cleanup will release into Steam Early Access on August 28th! [/b]

If you want to find out more about this announcement, or watch our new Release Date Announcement Trailer, check our our recent Steam post:
https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2748340/view/610914203288475765[h3]Excited for our Steam Early Access release on August 28th?[/h3]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Wc4FEc7H2]Discord [/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/GoblinCleanup]Twitter [/url]— we share dev updates, sneak peeks, and goblin nonsense regularly.

We hope you enjoy our demo update! 💚

notes.title: Goblin Cleanup enters Early Access on August 28th!
notes.content:
We’re excited to announce we have two pieces of major news, including our Steam Early Access release date for Goblin Cleanup...👀

[h3]Goblin Cleanup will enter Steam Early Access on August 28th, 2025![/h3]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/336ea0a05349160928ef540cfea1bbdd8a4fdb61.gif[/img]

Alongside the announcement of our EA release date, we’re also thrilled to announce our publisher partnership with Team17! We’ve been hard at work on our new Release Date Announcement trailer with Team17, which you can watch below: 👇

[previewyoutube=sTbtSDnfC_I;full][/previewyoutube]
[h2]New to Goblin Cleanup? 🧹[/h2]
In Goblin Cleanup, you assume the role of a professional cleaner hired by the dungeon manager to clean and prepare the dungeon for the next adventure. You can perform this task alone or with up to three companions, cooperatively or maybe not so cooperatively!

Be careful because the dungeons are dark and full of terrors, although as a professional cleaner this is not a problem, just don't step on a trap, and keep the monsters fed, you don't want them to eat you, or any of your friends.

[h3]Key Features[/h3]
[b]🧌 Goblin Maid:[/b] What better way to clean up than doing it like a pro? Play as a goblin alongside other goblins.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/17ce93f70554464453785ddfc594bb8a014f4384.gif[/img]

[b]🧹 Clean:[/b] It's your job to clean up the mess, so clean it up you shall! Use your Slimop, mimic, and slime dispenser tool to help you remove all that blood from the floor and ceiling!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/33fa3ab6a3f46b02315deeebcd0c77c200069bba.gif[/img]

[b]🪑 Restore Objects:[/b] To ensure the dungeon returns to its original state, you must restore objects and place them back in their original positions.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/cf992769faad9979fbdc79813a260b4d3afac7c0.gif[/img]

[b]⛓️Restore Traps:[/b] What kind of dungeon would it be without traps? You'll need to restore and reactivate them. Be cautious; there might be traps that weren't triggered by adventurers and are still active.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/b2ffbef70ddd997e538a0200f683e3b9db08d575.gif[/img]

[b]👹 Creatures: [/b]You'll also need to respawn creatures and dispose of their remains. Additionally, some creatures might not have perished.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/8f3674c4a85913fed39d44211535290a02b8aaab.gif[/img]

[h3]Excited for our Steam Early Access release on August 28th?[/h3]
Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Wc4FEc7H2]Discord [/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/GoblinCleanup]Twitter [/url]— we share dev updates, sneak peeks, and goblin nonsense regularly.

Thank you for your support! 💚

notes.title: We're SO Back with Progress! ✨
notes.content:
We know it's been a while since our last update — but no worries, development on Goblin Cleanup is moving forward at full speed. We're fully focused on releasing the[b] Early Access in Q3 this year[/b], and things are coming together.


[h3]🧹 Customization & Third-Person View[/h3]
We’ve now fully implemented the character customization system, letting you change your goblin’s appearance with different outfits and styles. You can also switch between first and third-person camera anytime during gameplay.

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMTk3OGJkMWl5ZmR4cjV3dThpNGhlM2RpbDgyMG5uaWZ2ZDAybHQ3ZCZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/YVRLfva8PPPY4mF6M4/giphy.gif[/img]


[h3]🛋️ New Lobby System: Staffhub[/h3]
No more creating a new lobby every time. Players now meet in a shared hub — the Staffhub — where you can select levels, prepare together, and hang out. Also: there’s a cat, and yes, you can pet it.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExMG40djZwNXdsM2NjaThhNnlrdjA4M2Z5dDJkNDkwcGYzY3lydThhcSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/6isvYR7YqTDhq24LYX/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]🔮 Mana System Overhaul[/h3]
We’ve made a small redesign to the mana system to make it a bit less… mindless. It’s now divided into three zones:

[b]Gray – Off

Green – On

Red – Overcharged, triggering an extra effect[/b]

To properly restore an object, the mana level must be in the green zone.
[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdThpZnV1NWI3YTI1cncydW9xN2xoaHJ4ZWdmcHJjY2FuNzB4b3c4eSZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/szDrPcvJn9bbs4edg6/giphy.gif[/img]


[h3]🧱 Level Updates & New Areas[/h3]
We’ve done a visual pass across all levels, improving the overall look and feel of the dungeon.
On top of that, we’ve added new levels including the Prison, the Dining Hall, and the Kitchen — each with their own messy challenges.

[img]https://media0.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExaWMxdTM0NHlpY2hxbjRpcjFqeG91MGZseWY2bnp0c2NsMDhnbTRnNyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/92DrAFoOhsA0lJJgpw/giphy.gif[/img]


[h3]👾 Monsters in the Dungeon[/h3]
We’ve started implementing several monsters across the dungeon. Enemies like the Carnivorous Plant, Spider, Cat, and Golem are now active, and we’re continuing to expand their behavior and interactions. More to come soon!

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExYmJkbHk5OWxha2cyNmQ0dGg2d2Y2OGU2MTFvaHNibmp2MWtudndubiZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/OPnenK8CTnbj4MQJJP/giphy.gif[/img]

[img]https://media3.giphy.com/media/v1.Y2lkPTc5MGI3NjExdXR4YzlubDZ3cnJjNXZ5NWdoN24wcWU5Y3dxNzZzcmFjcmRuaHBnZyZlcD12MV9pbnRlcm5hbF9naWZfYnlfaWQmY3Q9Zw/hW8QVYTfw3eFlKTZ84/giphy.gif[/img]

[h3]🧪 Other Features in Progress[/h3]

We're also working on several new features, including:

[list]
[*] Offline Singleplayer
[*] Save System
[*] Key Rebinding 
[/list]
...among other quality-of-life improvements and polish.


[h3]📢 Big Announcement Coming Soon[/h3]
We’re preparing a major announcement for mid next month. Stay tuned!

Want to follow development more closely? Join our [url=https://discord.gg/Wc4FEc7H2]Discord [/url] and follow us on [url=https://x.com/GoblinCleanup]Twitter [/url]— we share dev updates, sneak peeks, and goblin nonsense regularly.

Thanks for your support! 💚

notes.title: Halloween Update & Kickstarter Last days
notes.content:
[h1]🎃 Halloween Patch Update! 🎃[/h1]

We're excited to unveil our latest update, packed with spooky new features and essential bug fixes just in time for Halloween! This patch not only addresses various gameplay improvements but also introduces fun new content that enhances your experience in the game.

Check out the detailed patch notes below for all the changes and improvements, and prepare to enjoy a hauntingly good time!

[h2]Patch Notes[/h2]
[list]
[*][b] [New][/b] Halloween content added!
[/list]
[h3]Bug Fixes:[/h3]
[list]
[*] Fixed an issue with the Eye Trap remaining active even after the eye was removed.
[*] The base of the Eye Trap in Level 4 now has a collider.
[*] Resolved a sound glitch that persisted when dying while giving mana.
[*] Addressed a bug where meat could get stuck in the treasure chest on the first floor, causing excess blood.
[*] Cooking bug fixed: Meat and slimes that are skewered no longer cook automatically without right-clicking.
[*] Slimes and meat that are skewered can now be cooked on torches.
[*] Merged slimes can no longer be cooked
[*] Fixed an issue where the game would freeze when merging multiple slimes.
[*] Corrected a mimic placement bug where it always appeared diagonally.
[*] The mimic can no longer be dropped inside or near the staff room.
[*] Fixed a bug where jumping on small items (chairs, railings) could get players stuck in a falling state.
[*] Fixed connectivity issues when joining lobbies (Error Code 2).
[*] Fixed an issue where the dragon in the Great Room would wake up unintentionally when slipping on small rocks.
[*] Restorables will no longer be incorrectly restored by invisible objects.
[/list]
[h3]Gameplay Adjustments:[/h3]
[list]
[*] [b][New[/b]] Mimic now becomes friendly to the last player who feeds it cooked meat and won’t attack for a limited time.
[*] Reduced the sound when activating the altar and equipping the Managon.
[*] Optimized the first grill ignition and first scan, preventing the game from micro-freezing for a short time.
[*] The character's slippery movement has been improved, reducing slide effects.
[*] Jump and movement physics adjusted for more precise platforming.
[*] Slight reduction to strafe speed.
[*] Added speed reduction when moving up slopes or stairs. 
[*] Added an animation for when another goblin is carrying or dropping the mimic.
[*] Changed the lighting generated by sources other than mana torches (e.g., candles) to a "fake illumination" that is more performance-friendly.
[*] You can now hide the game HUD by pressing the Z key.
[*] You can now interact with the golden chests to open and close them.
[/list]


[h2]🎉 Exciting Update on Our Kickstarter Campaign! 🎉[/h2]

We are thrilled to announce that our [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gentleland/goblin-cleanup?ref=44ydig][b]Kickstarter [/b][/url]campaign is currently underway and has exceeded all our expectations! We have successfully [b]surpassed 400%[/b] of our initial funding goal thanks to the amazing support from our backers and community.

We've just reached our next stretch goal: [b]Hardcore Mode[/b]! With only 9 days left in the campaign, we’re eager to reach this milestone and provide you with even more exciting gameplay options.

Check out the image below for our current stretch goals and see what’s in store as we continue this journey together. Thank you for your incredible support!

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE - v0.40.0
notes.content:
Hello dear Goblins, we want to announce an important update in the Demo that brings with it several changes in gameplay, Quality of Life and content, as well as some Bugfixes.
This major update will be the one we will use to participate in the Steam next fest that will take place from the 10th to the 17th of next month, we hope you enjoy it!

We also added the possibility to leave us feedback and report bugs from the game by pressing (F8) or filling this [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/e/1FAIpQLSeAu-pS-IOwst53rCUxkwnFdzPljgTJMCaviNNW73zHFhPN6A/viewform]Form[/url]. Your opinion really matters to us!



[h1][b]Patchnotes:[/b][/h1]

[b]General:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Physics:[/b] Improved client-server physics.
[*][b]Controller Camera:[/b] Smoothed character and camera movement, significantly reducing motion sickness for some players.
[*][b]Loot Chest:[/b] Added a golden chest that needs to be filled with loot to complete the level.
[/list]

[b]Restorable Objects:[/b]
[list]
[*]Improved logic for updating objects correctly when adding or removing items.
[*]🆕 You can now place an object by pointing directly at the restorable.
[*]🆕 Added an "optional" type of restorable marked in green.
[*]🆕 Unrestored objects now have a red outline to easily distinguish them from restored objects.
[*]Fixed a bug where restored objects appeared floating or unrestored when joining an ongoing game.
[*]Improved UI while the object is being restored.
[*]Reduced restoration time from 2 seconds to 1 second.
[/list]

[b]Slime Dispenser:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Lever changed from grab to Interact (E)  to create slime.
[*]🆕 Can create between 1 to 4 slimes per interaction.
[*]🆕 Added a limit of 50 slimes.
[/list]

[b]Slime:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Big Slime, allows up to 4 slimes to combine for easier transport.
[*]🆕 Fire Slime, cleans multiple stains at once, cannot be combined into Big Slime.
[*]Slightly increased slime absorption capacity before death.
[*]🆕 Added a small delay after slime dies before it starts staining with blood, accompanied by a small animation and sound.
[*] Slightly increased absorption capacity
[/list]

[b]Tools:[/b]
[list]
[*][b]Slimop:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Now you can skewer meat chunks and feed the mimic.
[*]Fixed a bug where dropping the impaled object with (X) didn't work properly.
[/list]
[*]🆕 [b]Managon[/b]: The third tool to add and remove mana from objects. Objects with mana are highlighted in purple when targeted.
[/list]

[b]Blood Stain:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed a visual error where stains could look “stretched”.
[*]The visual appearance of the stains was improved and varieties were added.
[/list]


🆕[b]Mana Objects:[/b]
[list]
[*] New task to complete the dungeon by filling or emptying mana objects.
[*]Current mana objects:
[list]
[*]Vines
[*]Flowers
[*]Poisonous mushroom
[*]Torches
[*]Spinning blade
[/list]
[/list]

[b]Mimic:[/b]
[list]
[*]Adjusted behavior when eating multiple chunks of meat at once.
[*]Reduced interaction time to grab the mimic.
[*]Now shows a message when it cannot be placed.
[*]The mimic now shows affection when fed!
[/list]

[b]Levels:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Added 2 completely new levels and improved level 2.
[*]Removed level 1.
[/list]

[b]Objects:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Added the oven to cook slimes and meats.
[*]Removed the bucket (RIP 2024-2024).
[*]Added various props in different levels.
[*]Added various pickups in different levels.
[/list]

🆕[b]Altars:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added altars that function as respawn points. Activate an altar by interacting with it.
[/list]

🆕[b]Staff Room:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Added Staff Room at the beginning of each level.
[*]🆕 Added a punch clock in the staff room to end levels at any time.
[*]🆕 Added the employee book where you can read general help about the game mechanics.
[/list]

[b]Level Completion:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Progression system added to unlock levels.
[*]🆕 Reward system added, based on performance throughout the level.
[/list]

[b]Traps:[/b]
[list]
[*]Eye Trap: Adjusted behavior and received visual improvements
[list]
[*]🆕 Added ballista trap.
[*]🆕 Added spinning blade trap that works with mana.
[/list]
[/list]

🆕[b]Darkness System:[/b]
[list]
[*]First version of the light & darkness system.
[*]Reworked general lighting to match the new light and darkness system.
[/list]

[b]Communications:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Added ingame text chat.
[*]🆕 Added ingame voice chat.
[/list]

[b]Misc:[/b]
[list]
[*]🆕 Localization: Added translations for English, Spanish (Latin America), and Portuguese (Brazil).
[*]🆕 Controller Support: Full controller support for menus and gameplay.
[/list]

[b]Menu & UI:[/b]
[list]
[*]Revamped all menus to facilitate navigation with controller.
[*]Players can no longer join servers with different game versions.
[/list]

🆕[b]Tutorial:[/b]
[list]
[*]Added a tutorial visible only in level 1.
[/list]

[b]Bug Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Fixed several bugs including slimes falling through the floor, floating mimic, issues with the slime dispenser, and more.
[/list]

notes.title: 🎉 New DEMO Update V0.4.0!! 🎉
notes.content:
Hello dear Goblins, we want to announce an important update in the Demo that brings with it several changes in gameplay, Quality of Life and content, as well as some Bugfixes.
This major update will be the one we will use to participate in the Steam next fest that will take place from the 10th to the 17th of next month, we hope you enjoy it!

notes.title: We've got a Kickstarter!
notes.content:
Goblin Cleanup's demo launched just four months ago, and we've been overwhelmed by your amazing response! It's truly humbling, exciting, and so inspiring that finding the right words is almost a challenge!

First off, we want to share that we're diligently working on the next update for our demo. We're aiming to release it just before the upcoming Steam fest on June 10th. We apologize for the delay—being a small team of three, we're pushing ourselves to the limits to make this happen.

Here’s what you can expect in the upcoming update:

[list]
[*] The introduction of the third tool: Managon!
[*] Controller Support
[*] Localization in three languages: English, Spanish, and Portuguese (Brazil)
[*] Both voice and text chat functionalities
[*] An interactive tutorial
[*] Plus, exciting new levels!
[*] We've also been busy squashing bugs and implementing several quality of life improvements to enhance your gaming experience.
[/list]

And there's more big news—we're launching a [url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/gentleland/goblin-cleanup]KICKSTARTER [/url]campaign! While we're keeping the details under wraps for now, we’re planning fantastic rewards for our backers and are thrilled about producing a new trailer for the campaign launch.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44822240/51c7f62c9248161f8057ef7219f08a84c551e0b7.png[/img]

Check out Goblin Cleanup's "Coming Soon" page on Kickstarter and consider following us. Here’s the link: Goblin Cleanup Kickstarter.

The more support we receive, the bigger our launch will be. More followers mean more notice from Kickstarter, amplifying the excitement and anticipation.

Thank you for your continued support—it means the world to us!
